(i) the electrochemical impedance spectroscopic method can be applied for studying the interaction of amyloid beta peptides with (-) nicotine and cotinine; (ii) the interaction of (-) nicotine and (iii) cotinine with amyloid beta peptides can be described by the Langmuir isotherm model; (iv) the association constants for (-) nicotine and (-) cotine are 0.5 and 0.7 M(-1), respectively.
